items.exampleEn: In the middle of the film, my dad nodded off.

items.audioEn: I nodded off during the lecture because I'd stayed up too late finishing my report.

items.questionZh: 說話者為什麼在課堂上打瞌睡？
options: The lecture was on a boring subject
The speaker didn't get enough sleep

items.sentenceEn: After years of growth, sales have started to level off.
items.sentenceZh: 經過多年成長，銷售額開始趨於平穩。

items.sentenceEn: The teacher headed the argument off quickly.
items.sentenceZh: 老師很快就阻止了這場爭吵。

items.stemEn: After three days of talks, the two companies finally ____ a deal.
items.stemZh: 經過三天的談判，兩家公司終於敲定了一筆交易。

items.stemEn: After he lost his job, he had to ____ his savings for a year.
items.stemZh: 他失業後，有一年得靠積蓄過活。

items.passageEn: For years, the number of tourists visiting our island grew quickly, but recently it has leveled off. Local leaders are not worried. They say rapid growth caused problems that had been mounting up, such as traffic jams, crowded beaches and rising rents. Last year, the island council and hotel owners needed an agreement to limit new hotels, and after months of talks they hammered one out. Residents were also asked for their ideas, and many suggested more buses and bike paths. The council hopes the plan will protect the island's beaches for future visitors and for the people who live there all year.
items.passageZh: 多年來，來我們島上觀光的遊客人數成長得很快，但最近已經趨於平穩。地方領導人並不擔心。他們說，快速成長帶來了一些不斷累積的問題，例如塞車、海灘擁擠和房租上漲。去年，島上的議會和飯店業者需要一份限制新飯店的協議，談了好幾個月後終於敲定。居民也被請來提供意見，很多人建議增加公車和腳踏車道。議會希望這個計畫能為未來的遊客和一年到頭住在島上的人，保護島上的海灘。

questions.questionZh: 快速成長帶來了哪些問題？
options: 飯店的房間完全不夠住

questions.questionZh: 議會和飯店業者達成了什麼協議？

items.promptZh: 雙方花了好幾個月才敲定這份協議。
referenceEn: Both sides spent months hammering out this agreement.
It took the two sides months to hammer out the agreement.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「敲定」（例如 hammering out this agreement 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 working out、negotiating、finalizing this agreement 等）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 spent、took、have spent 等）
「花了好幾個月」可寫，例如 spent months、it took … months 等

items.promptZh: 這些數據會匯入新的天氣模型。
referenceEn: This data will feed into the new weather model.
These figures will feed into the new weather model.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「匯入」（例如 will feed into the new model 等）
不用片語但意思正確也算對（例如 will be added to、will go into、will be used in the new model 等）
時態可用未來式或現在式（例如 will feed into、feed into 等）
